changes: Extended the fiscal-year sample clock from 1979–1998 to 1979–2003, retaining the original start and fiscal-year labels.
Expanded accounting inputs through FY 2004 for the t+1 variables and calendar-year 2004 statements used by formation year 2005; expanded Xpressfeed rate bounds through 2005.

Extended CCM filtering and benchmark formations through formation year 2005 and CRSP/name/delisting/benchmark-return support through 2006-06-30, preserving the accepted investment-date, 12-month XRET, and July–June portfolio logic.

Added Stata e(sample) counts split by retained fyear into original years 1979–1998 and added years 1999–2003, with the last contributing fiscal year printed by the native fit. The pooled OLS terms and conventional covariance choice are unchanged.
limitations: The current local Compustat vintage does not establish membership in the original PST, full-coverage, or merged-research annual products.

The paper does not report Equation (1)'s regression N, estimator, standard-error method, degrees of freedom, or sidedness; the accepted reconstruction uses pooled OLS with conventional standard errors as a best-effort implementation.

The paper supplies no statement release dates for later June 30 target reassignment. The accepted construction applies its disclosed four-month publication-delay approximation and uses June market equity; refreshed book-to-market timing remains an implementation assumption.

The local Xpressfeed monthly rate series begins in 1982, so some historical non-USD flows before 1982 remain unavailable; this inherited limitation does not restrict the supported 1999–2003 extension.
Companies with unresolved PERMCO/name-history conflicts or incomplete common-issue market equity remain unavailable under the accepted complete-company mapping rule.
